profile.headline: Hubber @ GitHub
profile.summary: Lead Software Engineer that is flexible about technology and processes. Focuses on result driven development and developing maintainable code.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the design and implementation of Go microservices that coordinate the bundling, test, and release of host-your-own instances of GitHub while maintaining legacy Ruby systems.

Participated in volunteer opportunities on behalf of GitHub, leading workshops/seminars for NonProfits, students, and other entities.

Primary languages: Go, Ruby, and Bash.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of Research and Development for industrial software defined networking switch firmware. Lead a 6 person Linux firmware team. Responsible for making technical decision, designs, and participating in coding tasks.

Primary languages: C/C++, Python, and C#.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of Research and Development for industrial software defined networking switch firmware. Working primarily in Linux.

Primary languages: C/C++, Python, and C#.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the Test Engineering department implementing and maintaining software systems used in production of SEL products.

Primary languages/technologies used: C#, ANTRL, .NET, C, SQL, and GPIB.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the Test Engineering department implementing and maintaining software systems used in production of SEL products.

Primary languages/technologies used: C#, .NET, C, SQL, and GPIB.

positions.title: Senior Project
positions.description:
Sponsored by International Game Technologies to develop slot machine game
Developed in C++ and Lua script while learning and maintaining existing codebase and system
Coordinated long distance with employees at International Game Technologies

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Implemented bug fixes and new features on m2o mastery system both as a team and indivudual
    Coordinated with door and window plant managers to verify bug fix and new feature implementation
    Developed code in Edgenet with no debugger available

positions.title: Junior Project
positions.description:
Finished and integrated 2 interworking systems on a 3-person team
Designed and developed embedded control system using C, sent data to server using CDMA and XML
Designed and developed web based telemetry system using C#, Microsoft SQL, and ASP.NET
Generated interest from company Ambiente Motors and website was used in commercial application

positions.title: Quality Assurance Tester
positions.description:
Tested cases as volunteer quality assurance tester for CCP on video game EVE Online
Interfaced remotely with CCP quality assurance team using IRC chat and e-mail
